scope.purpose: Govern intentional decomposition of model and information containers.

requirements.statement: Each governed container shall have a clear ownership boundary and a declared breakdown rationale.
Container segmentation may use discipline/domain, system/subsystem, zone/area/building, level, phase/work package, and function/container role where supported by project need.
Containers shall not be split solely for individual-author convenience or temporary task slicing without coordination justification.
Duplicate modeling across containers shall not be used as a substitute for governed linking or federation.
Dedicated sheet or documentation container models shall not contain live physical model geometry where the source defines them as container-only models.
Ad-hoc container splits shall be registered through the project BEP and governed CDE/container register.

provenance.migration_note: Quantitative file-size, element-count, and polygon thresholds are absent from the source and are not invented here.
